description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for the ST VL53L1X time of flight sensor, including initialization, configuration, and measurement functions.

methods.name: vl53l1x_read_sensor
methods.description: Reads measurement data from the VL53L1X sensor and clears interrupt.

methods.name: vl53l1x_worker
methods.description: Worker function called in interrupt mode to read sensor data.

methods.name: vl53l1x_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO interrupt for the sensor.

methods.name: vl53l1x_initialize
methods.description: Performs one-time sensor initialization and configuration.

methods.name: vl53l1x_set_roi
methods.description: Sets the region of interest for measurement.

methods.name: vl53l1x_get_roi
methods.description: Retrieves the current region of interest.

methods.name: vl53l1x_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a new measurement sample from the sensor.

methods.name: vl53l1x_init
methods.description: Device initialization function called at startup.
